text.description_html:
Laurey Melrose Satin Brass Cabinet Bar Pull

The Melrose Satin Brass Cabinet Bar Pull is a great addition to any modern kitchen. The sleek, simple lines of these slim cabinet pull make it modern and the Satin Brass color finishes the look. The Satin Brass Melrose Cabinet Pull comes packaged with mounting hardware. Choose from a few different lengths.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Melrose Satin Brass Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Satin Brass
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available in 5 Sizes:

    LAU-87014:
    • C/C Length: 3"
    • Overall Length: 5"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-87104:
    • C/C Length: 3-3/4"
    • Total Length: 5-3/4"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-87204:
    • C/C Length: 4"
    • Total Length: 6"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-87304:
    • C/C Length: 5"
    • Total Length: 7"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-87404:
    • C/C Length: 7-1/2"
    • Total Length: 9-1/2"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"
